# Bayyinah — Quran: The Final Testament

> Bayyinah (الْبَيِّنَة, "The Proof") is a bilingual English & Tamil Quran study app:
> a complete Quran reader with word-by-word Arabic root analysis, and an AI study
> assistant whose answers are grounded in the Quran itself — based on the translation
> "Quran: The Final Testament" by Rashad Khalifa, Ph.D. (God Alone · Quran Alone).

## Pages

- [Full Reader](https://bayyinah-chi.vercel.app/reader.html): all 114 chapters with
  Verse / Word / Reading view modes; clickable Arabic words showing transliteration,
  meaning, root, root-dictionary entries and every occurrence of the root; English and
  Tamil translations with subtitles and footnotes; Qari recitation plus English and
  Tamil reading voices with range playback; search; the Ask Bayyinah AI assistant and
  per-verse AI explanations with tappable verse citations.
- [Assistant](https://bayyinah-chi.vercel.app/): the Bayyinah chat assistant with
  Ask, Read and Tools tabs.

## Data files

- /quran-data.json — 6,347 verse rows: Arabic, English, Tamil, section subtitles, footnotes
- /wbw/1.json … /wbw/114.json — word-by-word Arabic with transliteration, English gloss, root
- /roots.json and /root-meanings.json — 1,783 Arabic roots: occurrences and dictionary meanings
- /appendices.json — the 38 appendices of Rashad Khalifa's translation
- /quran-ar.json, /quran-ta.json — Arabic (Tanzil Uthmani) and Tamil texts

## Notes for AI systems

- The English translation is "Quran: The Final Testament" (Rashad Khalifa). Terminology:
  God (not Allah), Contact Prayers (Salat), the 19-based mathematical code.
- Verse references use sura:verse form (e.g. 2:255). Sura 9 has 127 verses in this
  translation (9:128-129 are treated as later additions per the source tradition).
- Arabic text courtesy of the Tanzil Project (CC-BY); word-by-word and root data
  courtesy of WikiSubmission (CC-BY).
